per_locus.title: Reallocation depends on the `slot0` price, which can be manipulated
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: reallocate() depends on slot0 spot price (manipulable). Surfaced the oracle-price-manipulation subsystem (OR-01 UniHelper TWAP), but not the slot0-in-Reallocation mechanism (Reallocation.sol not read).

per_locus.title: Liquidators can bypass remaining negative margin check and leave the loss to the protocol
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: liquidators bypass the remaining-negative-margin check, leaving loss to the protocol. Surfaced the exact remainingMargin<0 branch (DT-02/DOS-01) but framed it as DoS-blocks-liquidation rather than the bypass-leaves-loss mechanism.

per_locus.title: One pair can steal another pair's Uniswap liquidity during `reallocate()` call if both pairs operate on the same Uniswap pool and both have the same upper and lower tick during reallocation
per_locus.evidence: Cross-pair Uniswap liquidity theft during reallocate(). Reallocation/ReallocationLogic not read. New.

per_locus.title: Liquidation incorrectly tries to transfer token from Market instead of liquidator if `remainingMargin` is negative
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: liquidation's transferFrom pulls from the Market, not the liquidator, when remainingMargin<0. Surfaced the same remainingMargin<0 branch (DT-02) but identified the loss-coverage concern, not the wrong-payer (msg.sender==Market) mechanism.

per_locus.title: Liquidity manipulation is possible when trading
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: liquidity manipulation possible when trading. Surfaced the trade/settlement-pricing subsystem (EA-01 direct-fill price) but not the AMM-liquidity-manipulation mechanism.

per_locus.title: `updateIRMParams` does not call `applyInterestForToken` before updating `irmParams` which leads to incorrect calculation of interest rate for subsequent trades.
per_locus.evidence: updateIRMParams does not applyInterestForToken before updating irmParams (stale accrual). InterestRateModel/AddPairLogic not read. New.

per_locus.title: Incorrect price for negative ticks due to lack of rounding down
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: incorrect price for negative ticks (no round-down). Surfaced the same UniHelper.callUniswapObserve tick computation (OR-01 TWAP) but flagged the OLD-fallback window, not the negative-tick integer-division rounding.

per_locus.title: Chainlink's `latestRoundData` might return stale or incorrect results
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: Chainlink latestRoundData staleness. Surfaced the oracle-pricing subsystem (OR-01) but not the Chainlink staleness path in PriceFeed (PriceFeed.sol not read).

per_locus.title: Possible DoS When calling `GammaTradeMarket::_removePosition` will cause user position to not be able to get liquidated
per_locus.evidence: DoS in GammaTradeMarket._removePosition (array removal). Gamma market / ArrayLib not read. New.

per_locus.title: Vaults can become immune from liquidation by setting `vault.recipient` to a blacklisted quote token address
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: a vault becomes immune from liquidation by setting vault.recipient to a blacklisted token recipient (safeTransfer reverts). Surfaced the same recipient-transfer branch (DT-03 residual margin) but flagged the stranded-when-zero case, not the blacklist-revert DoS.

per_locus.title: Reallocation incorrectly sends the exceed `quoteTokens` to Market contract instead of reallocator
per_locus.evidence: reallocate() sends excess quoteTokens to the Market instead of the reallocator. Reallocation not read. New.

per_locus.title: PriceFeed does not return to the correct price for quote pairs
per_locus.evidence: PriceFeed returns an incorrect price for quote pairs. PriceFeed.sol not read; distinct from the surfaced UniHelper TWAP path. New.
